notes: Extends the temporary identifier diagnostic to trace the loader phase that emits each validation toast.
Tags module evaluation, Cyber Core initialization, each canonical item migration, V3 evaluation, and the stale-card sweep.
Stores captured validation notices at globalThis.__FEHA_LAST_IDENTIFIER_NOTICES and shows one persistent FEHA TRACE PHASES summary.
Retains the prior Item.update failure tracer and restores all wrapped methods before the loader exits.
No gameplay, catalog, balance, manufacturer, armor, or observer behavior changes are introduced.
